crossRefs.note: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

translations.web: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
translations.bsb: What use to me was the strength of their hands, since their vigor had left them?
translations.kjv: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
translations.asv: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.
